items.exampleEn: Planting more trees can alleviate summer heat in cities.
items.exampleZh: 多種樹可以緩和城市夏天的高溫。

items.exampleEn: Farmers here reap the wheat in late summer.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的農夫在夏末收割小麥。

items.exampleEn: You can bypass the long line by booking your tickets online.
items.exampleZh: 在網路上訂票，就可以不用排長長的隊伍。

items.exampleEn: Statues and festivals perpetuate the memory of the town's first mayor.
items.exampleZh: 雕像和節慶讓人們永遠記得這個小鎮的第一任鎮長。

items.exampleEn: Rumors abound about the singer's next album.
items.exampleZh: 關於那位歌手下一張專輯的傳聞很多。

items.exampleEn: The magician conjured a rabbit out of an empty hat.
items.exampleZh: 魔術師從一頂空帽子裡變出一隻兔子。

items.exampleEn: The meeting will break for a short recess at noon.
items.exampleZh: 會議中午會暫停，短暫休息一下。

items.exampleEn: His deep voice resonated through the empty hall.
items.exampleZh: 他低沉的聲音在空蕩蕩的大廳裡迴響。

items.sentenceEn: The children played soccer in the yard during recess.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們下課時在院子裡踢足球。

items.audioEn: To alleviate crowding, the museum now limits visitors to two hundred an hour.
items.audioZh: 為了減輕擁擠，博物館現在把參觀人數限制在每小時兩百人。
items.questionZh: 博物館為什麼限制參觀人數？
options: To make it less crowded inside

items.sentenceEn: Her speech about hope resonated with the whole audience.
items.sentenceZh: 她談希望的演講引起了全場觀眾的共鳴。

items.sentenceEn: Wild flowers abound in these hills in spring.
items.sentenceZh: 春天時，這些山丘上到處都是野花。

items.stemEn: Ignoring old mistakes will only ____ them for another generation.
items.stemZh: 忽視過去的錯誤，只會讓它們延續到下一代。

items.stemEn: Students who practice every day will ____ the rewards later.
items.stemZh: 每天練習的學生，日後會得到回報。

items.passageEn: For years, heavy trucks drove straight through the center of our small town, filling the streets with noise and smoke. Last year, the town finally built a new road that lets trucks bypass the center completely. From the outset, the aim was to alleviate the noise and make the old streets safer for walking. The town has already begun to reap the benefits. Cafes now put tables outside, and small shops abound along the main street. For many residents, the quiet streets conjure up memories of their childhood. The mayor's message, "Our streets belong to people," has clearly resonated with the community.
items.passageZh: 多年來，重型卡車一直直接穿過我們小鎮的中心，讓街道充滿噪音和廢氣。去年，鎮上終於蓋了一條新路，讓卡車可以完全繞過市中心。這條路從一開始的目的，就是要減少噪音，讓老街走起來更安全。小鎮已經開始享受到好處。咖啡館現在把桌子擺到戶外，主街上小店林立。對許多居民來說，安靜的街道讓他們想起童年。鎮長的口號「街道屬於人」，顯然引起了鎮上居民的共鳴。

options: 把鎮上和附近的大城市連起來
讓卡車更快抵達市中心
吸引更多觀光客來鎮上
減少噪音並讓老街更安全

items.promptZh: 這首歌引起許多年輕人的共鳴。
referenceEn: This song resonates with many young people.
The song has resonated with a lot of young people.
rubricZh: resonate with＋人表示「引起⋯的共鳴」（例如 resonates with many young people 等）
時態配合內容（例如 resonates、has resonated 等）

items.promptZh: 這張老照片讓我想起童年住過的小鎮。
referenceEn: This old photo conjures up the small town where I lived as a child.
This old photograph conjures up memories of the small town I grew up in.
rubricZh: 「讓我想起」用 conjure up（例如 conjures up the town、conjures up memories of… 等）
「童年住過的小鎮」可寫，例如 the town where I lived as a child、the town I grew up in 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 conjures up、conjured up 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（混合詞性題至少兩個干擾項放得進空格）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: recess 換成本課及物動詞 alleviate；bypass、alleviate 放得進 will ____ the rewards 但語意不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：resonate with＋人表示「引起⋯的共鳴」（例如 resonates with many young people 等）／時態配合內容（例如 resonates、has resonated 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：conjure up＋名詞表示「使浮現（腦海）、喚起」（例如 conjures up memories 等）／時態配合內容（例如 conjures up、conjured up 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（conjure）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u03-l05-q17；目標字沿用 conjure
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這張老照片讓我想起童年住過的小鎮。」、hintWords ["conjure"]、referenceEn ["This old photo conjures up the small town where I lived as a child.","This old photograph conjures up memories of the small town I grew up in."]、rubricZh ["「讓我想起」用 conjure up（例如 conjures up the town、conjures up memories of… 等）","「童年住過的小鎮」可寫，例如 the town where I lived as a child、the town I grew up in 等","時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 conjures up、conjured up 等）"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 conjure up 造一個句子，說說某個味道、聲音或地方讓你想起什麼。」、referenceEn ["The smell of rain always conjures up memories of my school days.","For me, the sound of the sea conjures up summer holidays with my family."]）
